Two additions to the PHA view, both about getting from a transcription to the
readable original:

- every document row — archived, new in the dropbox, or parked in the inbox —
  now has an "open" button (and the selected document's header an "Open
  source" one) that launches the original PDF or folder of page images in the
  OS-default app. It is backed by the new `pha open --source DOC|PATH`, which
  accepts an id/filename or a path inside the archive and lets pha validate
  containment;
- the page image now links to the same page in the `pha serve` viewer, a
  roomier browser tab, using the stable served address from `pha page --json`;
  the link states the caveat that `pha serve` must be running.
